answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can tie each identity to a costly, verifiable vertex in a reputation graph: agents earn trust only by completing attested work over time, so creating thousands of fake identities gains no shortcut. Reputation should peak at a zenith that requires sustained useful contributions, not mere account creation, and every agent carries a lantern of public history: past jobs, endorsements, and slashing events, visible to anyone choosing a counterparty. Cheap copies stay dim; real work shines.
